description: This file defines a PHP class 'SaleCoupon' which is a controller for handling report-related functionalities for sale coupons in the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for displaying reports, saving settings, and listing coupons.

classes.name: SaleCoupon
classes.description: Controller class for handling sale coupon reports in OpenCart's admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the sale coupon report form page, initializing necessary data and view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the sale coupon report configuration settings after permission validation.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the main sale coupon report based on filters.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of sale coupon reports in JSON format for AJAX requests.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the filtered report data as an HTML string or data array.
